messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D-style 1v1 fighting game featuring Aoi versus Haggar, or adapt the existing game.

## Requirements
- Aoi: 800 health, high damage (150 base), fast/mobile glass cannon.
- Haggar: 1500 health, good damage (120 base), slow heavy tank.
- UI text: “ROUND 1 - FIGHT!”, winner “WINS!”, match end “K.O.”
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (≤1280px wide) and inspect only the latest.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained browser game with hand-drawn canvas characters and a stylized sunset arena; no external game engine or assets.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with fighting HUD, touch controls, match overlay, and sound toggle.
- Created `style.css` with responsive desktop/mobile HUD and controls.
- Began `game.js` implementation: canvas arena and character rendering, fighter state, and HUD setup are present.

### Active
- Finish `game.js`: combat logic, AI, controls, canvas render/animation loop, and rematch/sound/touch event handling are not yet present.
- Validate the game with a browser run and screenshot; check for syntax/runtime issues.

### Blocked
- `(none)`

## Next Move
1. Continue implementing `game.js` from its current partial state, including attacks, hit detection, AI, controls, drawing loop, and rematch.
2. Run the game and fix any issues; verify desktop and touch play.
3. Save and inspect a current small JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game markup, HUD, overlays, controls.
- `style.css`: Game layout, HUD styling, responsive/touch presentation.
- `game.js`: Partial game implementation; currently ends after `drawFighter`.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- `game.js` has canvas/background/character drawing plus state initialization, but does not yet include combat/update/render loop or input event handlers.
